meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 让 Claude 根据文字描述,调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型(如 Gemini、FLUX)生成或编辑图片,存为 PNG。会先检查 API 密钥并提示配置方法;流程图、电路图等示意图改用 scientific-schematics 技能。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或修改照片、插画、概念图等一般用途图像,或基于参考图做图像合成时触发;如果要的是流程图、电路图等示意图,则由 scientific-schematics 处理,不走本技能。

say.text: 帮我画一张黄昏时分雪山湖泊的照片。
say.note: 图片会生成并保存为 PNG 文件。

say.text: 把这张照片的天空改成紫色。
say.note: 需先提供要修改的图片。

say.text: 用 FLUX 模型生成一只戴宇航头盔的猫。
say.note: 会按你指定的模型生成。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude create or edit images via OpenRouter image models (Gemini, FLUX), saving results as PNG. Checks API key, explains setup if missing. Flowcharts, circuits, and other technical diagrams use the scientific-schematics skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to create or edit photos, illustrations, concept art, etc., or composite from a reference image. Not for flowcharts, circuits, or other technical schematics.

say_en.text: Create a photo of snow-capped mountains by a lake at dusk.
say_en.note: Saves the result as a PNG file.

say_en.text: Change the sky in this photo to purple.
say_en.note: You need to provide the source image first.

say_en.text: Use the FLUX model to generate a cat wearing an astronaut helmet.
say_en.note: Uses the FLUX model as requested.
